entities.summary: Tigran Hamasyan (b. 1987-07-17, Gyumri) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Gyumri and Armenia. Known in the fields of armenia, composers & musicians, asia.
